messages:
maria.dev: Quick report — async Python client retried immediately on 503 even when server sent Retry-After, caused duplicate creates.

maria.dev: Minimal repro:
```py
client = AsyncClient(..., retry_policy=RetryPolicy(backoff_window_ms=200, max_retries=3))
await client.create_obj({'name':'dup'})
```

maria.dev: Server returned 503 + Retry-After: 2, async retried immediately. Sync honors header.

sophie: Likely we reuse aiohttp payload objects for replay; sync clones bytes.

patrick: Which module? _client/async/_replay.py? If so add clone for bytes or explicit buffer option.

tj: Two action items: (1) respect Retry-After in async retryer, (2) add safe replay strategy for streamed bodies (buffer/fail/factory). Unit tests for both.

infra-bot: ALERT: staging duplicates metric spiked at 2026-03-20T14:05:00Z.

maria.dev: Marking SDK fix P0 — customer-impacting.

sophie: I'll also fix a typing export for RetryPolicy that's causing mypy issues.

patrick: I'll open a WIP PR for Retry-After handling and tests, follow-up for body replay strategy. Tagging reviewers.

maria.dev: Thanks — please tag me, will validate on staging once changes land.
